title: Integrations
intro: Connect Yakka to Home Assistant, iOS Shortcuts, smart buttons and anything else that speaks HTTP.
docsHint: Full reference: docs/API.md in the Yakka repository.

pin.label: Settings PIN
pin.help: This group has a settings PIN. Enter it to make changes here.

errors.PIN_LOCKED: Too many wrong PINs. Try again in {wait}.
errors.URL_SCHEME_NOT_ALLOWED: Only http:// and https:// URLs are allowed.
errors.URL_CREDENTIALS_NOT_ALLOWED: Don't put a username or password in the URL.

common.name: Name
common.revokeConfirm: Revoke “{name}”? Anything using it stops working immediately.
common.showOnce: Copy it now: it won't be shown again.

tokens.title: API tokens
tokens.description: Bearer tokens for the REST API. A token can read and complete chores in this group only.

hooks.title: Inbound hooks
hooks.description: A secret URL per chore. POST to it (any body) to tick the chore off — ideal for buttons, NFC automations and Shortcuts.
hooks.postOnly: Only POST works: opening the URL in a browser does nothing, so link previews can't trigger it.
hooks.maskedHint: The URL is the secret. Showing it needs the settings PIN if the group has one.

webhooks.title: Outbound webhooks
webhooks.description: Yakka POSTs signed JSON to your URL when things happen.
webhooks.secretHelp: Verify the X-Signature header with this secret (HMAC-SHA256 of "timestamp.body").
webhooks.rotateConfirm: Replace the signing secret? Receivers must be updated.
webhooks.autoDisabled: Disabled after repeated failures. Fix the receiver, then re-enable.
webhooks.deleteConfirm: Delete this webhook and its delivery history?
webhooks.failures: {count, plural, one {# consecutive failure} other {# consecutive failures}}
